message.content: {"issue": true, "summary": "In handleError function, when an error handler throws, the code attempts to set reply[kReplyNextErrorHandler] to Object.getPrototypeOf(errorHandler), but this can lead to an infinite loop if the prototype chain has a circular reference or if the parent errorHandler is not properly defined, causing the error handling to fail silently or behave unpredictably.", "edits": [{"path": "lib/error-handler.js", "old": "  // In case the error handler throws, we set the next errorHandler so we can error again\n  reply[kReplyNextErrorHandler] = Object.getPrototypeOf(errorHandler)", "new": "  // In case the error handler throws, we set the next errorHandler so we can error again\n  reply[kReplyNextErrorHandler] = errorHandler === rootErrorHandler ? null : Object.getPrototypeOf(errorHandler)"}]}
